rows.title: A permanent address page for cats, dogs and ferrets, with one card per animal and a same-as-destination choice
rows.detail: Each pet's permanent address is asked on its own page in the consignment parties section, opened from the consignment addresses page, instead of inside the animal identification form. Cats, dogs and ferrets need one. Other live mammals that share commodity code 01061900 do not. The page has a card for each animal that needs one, showing the identifiers already given, and asks for each whether the animal lives at the place of destination or at a new address, revealing the address fields only when a new address is chosen. Each animal's choice and address are stored with the notification, every field in its own place, and a trader can save what they know and come back.
acceptanceCriteria: A consignment with cats, dogs or ferrets has a 'Permanent address' section on the consignment addresses page explaining 'A permanent address is where an animal:' with the bullets 'will permanently reside' and 'can be checked by the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA)', and the link 'Add a permanent address' to the permanent address page; a consignment of cats alone has five sections and no county parish holding section (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-023, p9-025; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-085, p7-106; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-081; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p2-014, p2-015)

A consignment of cattle, horses or another 01061900 species, such as 'Carnivora excluding Canis familiaris, Felis catus, Mustela putorius furio', has a consignment addresses page with no permanent address section, and opening the permanent address page for it sends the trader to the consignment addresses page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-023, p9-024; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-109; document:dr1-parity-backlog p6-012, p6-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p2-014, p2-015)

The permanent address page has the caption 'Consignment parties', the heading 'Permanent address', the browser title 'Permanent address - Import notification service - GOV.UK' and a back link to the consignment addresses page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-021, p9-032, p9-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-109, p13-110; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-082, p3-108)
The animal identification page asks only for each animal's identifiers, and its species card ends with the identifier fields (document:dr1-parity-backlog p6-058; trace:e2e p6-028)

The page shows one card for each animal that needs a permanent address, as many as were entered for each species, headed with the scientific name and a running number such as 'Felis catus 1'; a ferret gets a card, and another 01061900 species on the same consignment gets none (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-037, p9-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-091, p13-111; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-084)

Each card shows the animal's entered identifiers in inset text as 'label: value', such as 'Microchip: MICROCHIP-1', leaving out blank ones, and shows no inset when none are entered (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-111)

Each card asks 'Select an address' with the options 'Same as the place of destination (POD)' and 'Enter a new address', neither chosen when the page first opens; once a place of destination is given, the first option's hint is that address on one line, such as 'Riverside Holding Facility, East Farm Road, Leeds, LS25 3EB, United Kingdom' (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-040, p9-041, p9-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-092, p7-094, p7-095, p13-112; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-085)

'Enter a new address' has the hint 'This is where they will stay after spending 48 hours at the place of destination.', and choosing it reveals that animal's own address fields inside its card, with 'Email address' before 'Phone number' (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-042, p9-043, p9-050, p9-051; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-093, p7-097, p7-098, p13-113; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-086, p3-090)

Outside an amendment the page ends with the primary 'Save and continue' button alone, which saves and returns to the consignment addresses page (document:dr1-parity-notes p1-055, p1-056, p1-058; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-104; prototype:dr2-1-source p9-077)

An animal saved as 'Same as the place of destination (POD)' has the place of destination's name, address, country, email and phone as its permanent address on the review page, and reopening the permanent address page shows that option selected (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-067, p9-068; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-115; prototype:dr2-1-specs p4-039)

A new address saved with a county and no address line 2 reopens with 'Enter a new address' selected, each value in its own field: the county in 'County', the town in 'Town or city' and the postcode in 'Postcode or Zip code', with country United Kingdom (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 p1-010; prototype:dr2-1-source p9-068; trace:e2e p6-032)

An animal left with no option chosen is saved with no permanent address: the page saves the other animals and returns to the consignment addresses page, the permanent address section there reads as incomplete, and the notification cannot be submitted until every animal that needs one has an address with a name (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-062, p9-063, p9-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-102; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-089)

With the Welsh language chosen, every new string on the permanent address page and the addresses page's permanent address section shows in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-050, p10-083)

rows.title: The permanent address page checks each new address, names the animal in every error, and answers errors as an error page
rows.detail: With several animals on one page, the trader must be told which animal each error is about. A new address's name, first line, town, postcode, email and phone are required exactly when 'Enter a new address' is chosen, and the same-as-destination choice cannot be used before a place of destination exists. What the trader chose and typed is kept through an error and when the page is reopened, and the page explains what to do when no animals have been counted yet. Like the county parish holding and contact address pages, its error state is titled 'Error: ' and answered with HTTP 400.
acceptanceCriteria: With 'Enter a new address' chosen and the fields left blank, saving shows 'Enter a name or organisation name', 'Enter address line 1', 'Enter a town or city', 'Enter a postcode or Zip code', 'Enter an email address' and 'Enter a phone number' on those fields; address line 2 and county save with any value or none, and email, phone and postcode are checked only for being blank (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-054 to p9-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-101; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-105; trace:e2e p6-036 to p6-042)

Each address error in the error summary names its animal, such as 'Enter a name or organisation name for Felis catus 1' and 'Enter address line 1 for Felis catus 1', and links to the field; the message on the field itself reads 'Enter address line 1' (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-054 to p9-059; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-100; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-091)

Choosing 'Same as the place of destination (POD)' before a place of destination is given shows 'Add a place of destination before you can continue' on that animal's radios and in an error summary titled 'There is a problem', linked to the radios (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-053, p9-053-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-096; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-088)

When the page shows errors, every animal's chosen option stays selected and a chosen 'Enter a new address' stays open with what was typed; reopening the page later shows each animal's saved choice selected and its saved address filled in (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-064, p9-064-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-100-m1; trace:e2e p6-043)

With no animals that need a permanent address counted, the page shows 'Add the number of animals on consignment details before you can continue.', with 'consignment details' linking to that page, in place of the cards; saving from there leaves the notification as it was and returns to the consignment addresses page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-065, p9-066)

When the permanent address page shows errors, its browser title starts 'Error: ' and the page answers with HTTP status 400; the county parish holding and contact address pages do the same in their error states (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 p1-010; trace:animals-fit p13-005, p13-030, p12-052; repo:frontend p10-034, p10-071)

With the Welsh language chosen, every new error message and the no-animals message show in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-050)

The review page lists each animal's permanent address so the trader can check them before submitting.

rows.title: The county parish holding number page: who is asked, its help and hint, a blank save, and where it goes
rows.detail: A county parish holding (CPH) number is asked for every live animal kept on a holding. In the live-animals set the question applies to cattle, pigs, sheep, goats and poultry, built now over the commodities today's catalogue holds, so the same rule takes in the rest once the reference catalogue holds them with no further change. The page cannot be opened for a consignment it does not apply to. Its help gains a second place to find the number, the hint loses its punctuation, the boxes stop browsers offering saved values, and a trader can save the page blank and move on, with the gap held at submission instead. The page is a step of the consignment addresses section: opened from that page and always returning to it. The plants frontend asks for no county parish holding number and is not changed. Every changed English string gets its Welsh machine draft in the same change.
acceptanceCriteria: A consignment holding cattle (0102), pigs (0103), sheep (010410), goats (010420) or poultry, whether day-old chicks, adult birds or hatching eggs, has a 'County parish holding (CPH) number' section on its consignment addresses page; a consignment holding only horses or 01061900 pets has none, and opening the county parish holding number page for it sends the trader to the consignment addresses page (confluence:6497338582 p2-099, p2-107 to p2-126; prototype:dr2-1-source p9-001, p9-002; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-106; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-025, p1-057)

The county parish holding help's second paragraph reads 'You can find your CPH number on documents from the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA) or by checking your holding details on GOV.UK.', with 'checking your holding details on GOV.UK' a link to https://www.gov.uk/guidance/get-a-county-parish-holding-cph-number (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-009; trace:animals-fit p13-018; trace:e2e p6-084)

The county parish holding question's hint reads 'For example 12/345/6789' and describes the whole group of three boxes (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-010; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-119; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-040; trace:animals-fit p13-007)
Each of the three boxes turns browser autocomplete off and carries the pattern [0-9]* alongside the numeric input mode (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-012; trace:animals-fit p13-014)

Saving the county parish holding number page with all three boxes empty leaves the notification with no county parish holding number, returns the trader to the consignment addresses page, leaves that page's county parish holding section reading as incomplete, and the notification cannot be submitted until a number is added (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-014, p9-015, p9-004, p8-135; confluence:6497338582 p2-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 p1-024)

The county parish holding number page's back link goes to the consignment addresses page however the page was reached (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-021; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-117; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-043; trace:e2e p6-078)

'Save and continue' on the county parish holding number page returns to the consignment addresses page, whether the page was opened from that page, from the overview or from review (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-018; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-043; trace:e2e p6-074)

With the Welsh language chosen, the changed help paragraph and hint show in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-050, p10-051, p10-052, p10-053)

rows.title: The consignment addresses and review pages show the county parish holding number as 12/345/6789
rows.detail: On the consignment addresses page the empty county parish holding row offers the link 'Add a CPH number', and a saved number reads in the slashed county/parish/holding form traders know, on that page and on the review page. In the journey's first pass, 'Save and continue' on the consignment addresses page moves on to the contact address page whether or not the county parish holding number applies: that page is one of the addresses page's sections, reached from its own link, not a step after it. Opened from its overview task, the addresses page returns to the overview instead, as every overview-opened page does.
acceptanceCriteria: The consignment addresses page's county parish holding section is headed 'County parish holding (CPH) number', described 'The county parish holding (CPH) number identifies the holding where the animals will be kept.', sits after the place of destination, and before a number is saved offers the link 'Add a CPH number' (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-003, p9-004; trace:e2e p6-071, p6-072, p6-073)

In the journey's first pass, 'Save and continue' on the consignment addresses page goes to the contact address page, whether or not the county parish holding number applies; opened from its overview task, the page returns to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-144; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-196, p1-197, p1-198)

rows.title: With JavaScript, the county parish holding boxes keep out non-digits and one paste fills all three, if design keeps it
rows.detail: Traders often copy the whole county parish holding number from an APHA document. The prototype's script drops anything that is not a digit as it is typed and spreads a pasted number across the boxes. This waits on design: the page already works without JavaScript, with the server's checks, and this script is built as design answers or dropped if design drops it.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, typing a letter, space or slash into a county parish holding box leaves the box as it was, and the script alone stops County, Parish and Holding at 2, 3 and 4 digits. Without JavaScript the boxes take any length, and a whole number typed in County is split on save. (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-011, p9-012)
With JavaScript, pasting '123456789' or '12/345/6789' into County fills County with 12, Parish with 345 and Holding with 6789 (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-012-m3)
With JavaScript, pasting '3456789' into Parish fills Parish with 345 and Holding with 6789, leaving County as it was (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-012-m3)
Filling a box leaves the keyboard focus in that box (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-012)
openQuestions: Design question 7 is answered for the boxes (Sam, 20 Oct): three labelled boxes as drawn, no cursor jump, the whole number kept when typed or pasted in one go, already built without JavaScript. Still for design: whether the JavaScript digit filter and paste spreading are wanted on top. Built as design says, or dropped if design drops it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-044, p1-046, p1-048, p1-071, p1-072; c-288).
notes: Carried over from the existing row inc-093, still blocked: req-711 and req-712 both carry blockedBy design question 7 (c-288). The criteria stay as what the row builds if design keeps the prototype's behaviour; rewrite them to design's answer when it comes. Its theme is waiting-on-design.

c-006: no automatic focus moves (req-713 out of scope). c-114 and req-715: the server's per-part errors stay as the backstop.

It is the first client script on this page and needs its own bundle entry and its own with- and without-JavaScript proof. Keeps its existing external dependency on the design-snagging-b split's inc-219.

rows.title: The contact address page says whose address it is, requires a choice, and goes on to review
rows.detail: The contact address page says whose address this is, puts the choice under its own 'Select an address' heading, shows each address without its country, requires a choice before the trader moves on from either save button, and in the journey's first pass goes from there to the review page, its back link returning to the consignment addresses page. The choice stands alone: the notification stores the chosen contact as a copy of its address-book record, shown on the review page, and nothing is submitted without a contact address. The plants consignment contact page takes the same intro sentence and 'Select an address' heading, and saving it at the end of the plants opening run goes on to the plants review page even when the notification is incomplete.
acceptanceCriteria: Directly under the live-animals contact address page's heading, body text reads 'This is the contact address of the person responsible for the consignment from when it enters Great Britain until authorities complete their checks.' (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-117; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-067, p12-140, p13-123; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-095; document:dr1-parity-backlog p7-023 to p7-027; trace:e2e p7-006)

Below the intro the live-animals contact address page has the sub-heading 'Select an address' as an h2, and the radios' fieldset legend 'Select an address' is visually hidden, so the page's only visible heading above the choice is the page heading (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-118; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-068; repo:frontend p10-058; trace:e2e p8-074)

The plants 'Contact address for consignment' page's description reads the same intro sentence and its results carry the same 'Select an address' heading; no other plants picker's description changes (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-043; repo:plantsfrontend p7-048, p7-049)

With the Welsh language chosen, the new intro and 'Select an address' heading show in Welsh on the live-animals contact address page, and the new intro on the plants contact page, each marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-083, p10-084; repo:plantsfrontend p7-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-043)

Each live-animals address option is labelled with the address's name and hinted with its address lines joined by commas, ending at the postcode, such as '15 Union Street, Aberdeen, AB11 5BN' (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-122; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-070, p13-125; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-098; trace:e2e p7-010, p7-011)

The live-animals contact address page shows the address options with the current contact pre-selected, and the save controls directly below the options (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-122; trace:e2e p7-026)

'Save and continue' on the live-animals contact address page with no address chosen keeps the trader on the page, with 'Select a contact address' in the error summary linked to the first radio and on the radios themselves, and the notification's contact address as it was (confluence:6497338582 p2-131; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-100; trace:e2e p7-022)

The secondary save button that returns to the overview makes the same check: with no address chosen, or with an address that is not in the list, the trader stays on the page with 'Select a contact address' in the error summary and on the radios, and the notification's contact address is as it was (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 p1-001, p1-024; confluence:6497338582 p2-131; repo:frontend p10-081)

In the journey's first pass, reached from the consignment addresses page, choosing a contact address and pressing 'Save and continue' saves it and goes to the review page headed 'Review your notification'; opened from its overview task or from the review page, the same button returns there (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-126, p8-128; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-075, p7-076, p12-144; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-196)

The live-animals contact address page's back link goes to the consignment addresses page, or to the review page when the page was opened from review (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-132; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-074, p12-143, p13-122; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-112; trace:e2e p7-062)

Pressing the declaration's submit button on a notification with no contact address keeps the trader on the review page, which shows the contact address task as needing an answer (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-135; repo:frontend p10-055)

rows.title: The contact address page offers only the trader's own branch addresses and adds a new branch through the address book
rows.detail: The contact is the trader's own branch responsible for the consignment in Great Britain, so the page lists only the organisation's branch addresses, not overseas consignors and other parties. When the right branch is missing, the page tells the trader how to add one: the link opens the address book ready to add a branch address, and on saving the address book returns the trader to the contact address page with the new branch chosen and a success banner.
acceptanceCriteria: The live-animals contact address page offers the signed-in organisation's own branch addresses, newest added first, and offers no consignor, place of origin, consignee, importer, place of destination or transporter from the same address book (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-123; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-141, p13-125; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-097; document:dr1-parity-backlog p6-039 to p6-045; document:dr1-parity-notes p1-019, p1-020, p1-022, p1-023; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-119)

On the full stack, the only way to add an address sits under 'Select an address' and reads 'If the correct address is not shown, add a new branch address, then return to this page.', with 'add a new branch address' as the link; in stub mode, with no address book service, the page offers the radios and the save controls alone, as today (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-118; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-069, p12-141, p13-124; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-096; repo:frontend p10-067; trace:e2e p7-031, p8-075)

On the full stack, the link opens the address book's add-address page set to add a 'Branch' address (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-119, p8-120; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-079 to p7-082; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-102; trace:e2e p7-032, p7-080; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-092)

On the full stack, saving the new branch address returns the trader to the contact address page, where the new address is in the list and selected, and the success banner '<name> address added to your address book' shows once and is gone on reload (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-121; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-083, p7-084)

With the Welsh language chosen, the add-a-branch sentence and the success banner show in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-084)
openQuestions: Where the organisation's contact addresses ultimately come from is open: the Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields page gives the contact address a government-identity row as well as a user-created one (c-359). Default followed: the list stays the organisation's own address book, filtered to branch addresses, until that is settled.

Live animals only: no ruling carries the branch-only list or the add-a-branch path to the plants contact page, which keeps listing the whole address book with no add link (req-1966, exists; c-291).
The INS front door's add page must accept the branch type from the handshake; the return already runs through the journey's address-return step by fulfilment id.

rows.title: While amending, the permanent address and contact address pages end with 'Save and return' and 'Save and continue'
rows.detail: While a notification is amended, the county parish holding number, permanent address and contact address pages offer 'Save and return' to the review page and a secondary 'Save and continue', as every other amended page does; outside an amendment each keeps its primary button alone. None of them carries a cancel link or a cancel-amend dialog: cancelling an amendment goes through the Amend bar's 'Cancel amend' to the cancel amendment confirmation page. The plants consignment contact page takes the same two buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: While a notification is being amended, the county parish holding number, permanent address and contact address pages each end with a primary 'Save and return' button that saves and goes to the review page and a secondary 'Save and continue' button that saves and goes to the next step, and with no other control; outside an amendment each ends with its primary button alone (prototype:dr2-1-source journey-form-actions.html:7-10, 44-56 p1-074; cph-number.html p9-020; permanent address p9-078; contact address p8-131; document:dr1-parity-notes p1-055, p1-056, p1-057, p1-058; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-078, p1-082, p1-084)

Cancelling an amendment from any of these pages is done from the Amend bar's 'Cancel amend', which opens the cancel amendment confirmation page; the pages themselves show no cancel control and open no dialog (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-078, p1-084; trace:e2e p14-088)
The plants consignment contact page ends with the same two buttons while a notification is being amended (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-028)

rows.title: Every save control on the county parish holding, permanent address and contact address pages makes the same checks
rows.detail: A trader who leaves a page by any of its save buttons should be told what is missing or wrong, rather than carrying an unchecked answer into the overview. On the county parish holding number, permanent address and contact address pages, and the plants consignment contact page, 'Save and return', 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview' each check exactly what that page needs before the trader moves on, and each takes the trader where its own wording says once the answers are given and valid.
acceptanceCriteria: While a notification is being amended, pressing 'Save and return' on the contact address page with no address chosen keeps the trader on the page with 'Select a contact address' in the error summary and on the radios, the notification's contact address as it was, and the trader's own choice still shown; with an address chosen it saves and goes to the review page (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 p1-001, p1-024; confluence:6497338582 p2-131)

While a notification is being amended, the secondary 'Save and continue' on the contact address page makes the same check and, with an address chosen, saves and goes to the next step (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 p1-001, p1-024)

'Save and return to overview' on the contact address page makes the same check and, with an address chosen, saves and goes to the notification overview (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 p1-001, p1-024; repo:frontend p10-081)

On the county parish holding number page, which requires no answer before the trader moves on, every save control the page offers saves what was entered, reports a part-entered number with its own per-part messages, and otherwise goes where its own wording says (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 p1-024; repo:frontend p10-033)

On the permanent address page, which requires no answer before the trader moves on, every save control the page offers applies the page's own new-address checks and, with those passed, saves and goes where its own wording says (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 p1-024)

On the plants consignment contact page, every save control the page offers makes the same checks as each other and goes where its own wording says (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 p1-024; repo:plantsfrontend p7-088)

notes: New on this re-distil, for req-2188, which the 26 October ruling brought in. It is kept apart from the amend-endings row because that row builds which controls each page offers, while this one builds what each control checks, and from the contact address row because that row's check is the first-pass 'Save and continue' alone.

req-2188 is one requirement that reaches further than this area. Its upload-documents clause (a part-filled document refused by every save control, with an error for each missing detail) falls in the documents feature folder, which the split-off documents theme owns, so no criterion here builds it: hand that clause to that branch. Its germinal-products clause is picked up by the germinal set's copy of each live-animals page, in the germinal-products theme.

The three amend controls themselves are the journey-foundation split's (req-1403, req-2068), and the consignment-parties theme already lands after journey-foundation, so this row needs no dependency of its own on that branch. It depends on the contact address row (which puts the first check in validate.js) and on the amend-endings row.

c-361 and c-370: the county parish holding and permanent address pages require nothing before the trader moves on, so the same-check rule changes nothing they refuse; it only makes every control run the checks the page already has. c-362: the contact address page requires a choice, so every control refuses a blank save.

rows.title: The germinal products set asks for no county parish holding number and no permanent address
rows.detail: Germinal products are not kept on a holding and are not pets, so the germinal products set, copied from the live-animals addresses feature, leaves out the county parish holding number and permanent address sections and pages the live set has. A trader importing germinal products is only ever asked for the five consignment addresses.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification's consignment addresses page shows exactly five sections, in this order: Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-002, p9-024; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-017, p1-018, p1-057)

Nothing in the germinal products set links to or asks for a county parish holding number or an animal's permanent address, and opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows 'Page not found' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-006, p1-014, p1-017, p1-018, p1-025)
notes: existingRow inc-181: the existing row already holds req-1832 and req-1833 with these two criteria, alongside req-1826 and req-1827 from the consignment-parties area and req-1840 from the notification-hub area. It is the same copied page, and building these apart would copy the page twice. The combiner keeps inc-181's id, its germinal-products theme, its other requirements and its existing dependencies, and removes repeats between the drafts.
Criterion 1 now states the five sections the germinal page shows instead of naming the two it has no copy of; criterion 2 keeps its positive 'Page not found' outcome.

Observable only once the germinal set's own mount, overview and addresses page exist; the copy waits for the live county parish holding and permanent address rows, so the live pages it leaves out are in their new form.

The live county parish holding rule no longer names the germinal codes 05111000 and 05119985 (ruling sam-2026-10-09 p1-026), so nothing in the live set brings the question into a germinal consignment either.
